lines.text: Jesus says He is the light of the world, and whoever follows Him will have the light of life.
The Pharisees say His testimony is invalid, but Jesus says the Law counts the testimony of seven men valid.
Jesus teaches near the treasury in the temple courts, and no one seizes Him because His hour had not come.
Jesus says they will die in their sins, and they must come where He is going.
Jesus says the Father who sent Him is with Him, and as He speaks, many believe in Him.
